title: Singapore
tagline: A garden city of skylines, islands and cruises
description: Singapore packs a world of experiences into one spotless island. Marina Bay's skyline glitters by night, the Supertrees of Gardens by the Bay glow above lush conservatories, and every neighbourhood — Chinatown, Little India, Orchard Road — has its own flavour and food.
Spend a day at Universal Studios or on Sentosa's beaches, ride the Night Safari, and add a couple of nights at sea aboard a cruise for a holiday that suits honeymooners and families alike.
